abilities.name: Holy Light
abilities.description: Restore an ally with a flash of warm light, or sear an enemy with it.

abilities.name: Rally the Colony
abilities.description: Persistent aura: nearby allies and the Marshal gain 8/12/16% movement speed and 10/15/20% attack speed within 4 grid cells. Requires learning, costs no mana. Only the strongest copy applies; ends outside the aura or when the Marshal dies.

abilities.name: Horn Rush
abilities.description: Charge a visible ground enemy, respecting terrain and other bodies. On contact deal 70/115/160 spell damage and stun for 0.75/1/1.25 seconds. Blocked, interrupted or escaped charges do not hit.

abilities.name: Overwhelm
abilities.description: Each damaging primary melee hit marks its target for six seconds, stacking three times. Subsequent basic attacks from this hero gain 5/10/15 damage per stack; the target loses 5/7/10% movement per stack. First hit has no bonus. Hits refresh all stacks; allies do not gain the damage bonus.

abilities.name: Steadfast Aura
abilities.description: Nearby allied units regenerate 1/2/3 additional health per second within four grid cells. Only the strongest copy applies. Ends when the Hornbreaker falls or an ally leaves the aura.

abilities.name: Colossus
abilities.description: Become a living siege engine for 18/24 seconds: gain 300/500 maximum health and health, 12/20 damage, 3/5 armor, and 35/50% frontal cleave within 1.5 cells. Physical clearance is unchanged; expiry caps health at the normal maximum.

abilities.name: Thorn Rush
abilities.description: Lunge almost instantly into a visible ground enemy and strike for 18 damage on contact. Autocast is enabled by default and can be toggled. Stops at obstructing terrain or units.

abilities.name: Silken Snare
abilities.description: Bind an enemy in silk for 4 seconds (2 on heroes), grounding airborne units until the silk breaks.

abilities.name: Nectar Mend
abilities.description: Restore 90 health to an injured ally with a drop of restorative nectar. Autocast can be disabled.

abilities.name: Nectar Cleanse
abilities.description: Wash harmful dispellable effects from an ally with purifying nectar.

abilities.name: Rallying Standard
abilities.description: Raise the colony standard, granting allied units within 16 range 15% additional attack damage for 12 seconds. Autocast rallies when enemies are nearby.

abilities.name: Amber Sever
abilities.description: Strip dispellable positive effects from a visible enemy. Does not remove auras or permanent upgrades.

abilities.name: Amber Seal
abilities.description: Seal an enemy’s spellcasting for 3 seconds (1.5 on heroes). Autocast targets enemies with mana remaining. Weapons and movement remain available.

abilities.name: Royal Guard
abilities.description: Nearby allied units gain 2 armor within 10 world units. Copies do not stack. Protection ends on leaving range or when the guard falls.

abilities.name: Shield Brace
abilities.description: Brace behind the tower shield for 8 seconds, gaining 4 armor while moving 40% slower.

abilities.name: Root Bind
abilities.description: Autocast: entangle a ground enemy for 5 seconds (2 on heroes), preventing movement and attacks and dealing 10 spell damage each second.

abilities.name: Briar Patch
abilities.description: Grow a 5-radius patch of roots for 6 seconds. Enemy ground units inside move 35% slower and take 6 spell damage each second. The patch persists if its caster dies.

abilities.name: Faultline
abilities.description: Slam the mace to send a travelling fracture through enemies: 70/110/150 spell damage and a brief 0.4/0.5/0.6-second stun. Heroes are stunned for half as long.

abilities.name: Iron Carapace
abilities.description: Harden the Marshal’s chitin for six seconds: take 20/30/40% less damage and reflect 15/25/35% of ordinary melee damage actually suffered. The Marshal can still move and cast.

abilities.name: Crownfall
abilities.description: Call down an amber crown with a thunderous mace strike. After a visible windup, deal 180/260 spell damage and stun enemies for 1/1.4 seconds (half against heroes) in a 7/9-unit radius. Up to sixteen allies in the impact area gain a 100/160-damage shield for six seconds.

abilities.name: Crushing Presence
abilities.description: A quiet persistent aura reduces nearby enemy armor by 2/3/4 within 16 world units. The strongest copy applies. The ring stays under Rootbreaker even with no enemy nearby; learning is required.

abilities.name: Skullcrack
abilities.description: A heavy overhead club strike deals 120/190/260 physical damage and stuns one ground enemy for 1.2/1.6/2 seconds (half against heroes). Has a visible 0.7-second windup and must connect at melee range.

abilities.name: Challenge Roar
abilities.description: Force nearby enemies within 12 units to attack Rootbreaker for 2/2.5/3 seconds (half against heroes), and gain 4/6/8 armor for 5 seconds. Enemies resume their orders afterward. Taunt and the armor ward can be dispelled.

abilities.name: Uproot
abilities.description: Smash the ground to erupt thick roots and stone in an aimed area within 16 units. Ground enemies in an 8-unit radius take 220/330 physical damage, are stunned for 0.8/1.2 seconds (half against heroes), and slowed by 35% for 3 seconds. The roots are a temporary visual eruption, not a permanent terrain obstacle.
